about_the_game:
Slingshot Quest is an RPG with turn-based combat, set in a fantasy world where a war between species wages on.

Save The World. Slay The Dragon.

You play as Charlie, a Slingshot-user unsatisfied with his role as a healer. Your short trip to rescue your bird companion quickly turns into an ambitious quest to save the world, together with a rag-tag team of fellow fighters you meet along the way.

Meet Unlikely Friends. Strengthen Your Bonds.

Form a close bond with four quirky allies, transcending the conflicts between species to work towards a common goal. Manage your party's stats and equipment, levelling them up after each thrilling fight.

Explore Dangerous Dungeons. Push Beyond Your Limits.

Working your way up from barely surviving in an abandoned, small fortress to conquering the lairs of the Void Dragon Itself, you'll see yourself growing stronger and more capable with every battle won.

Master The Combat. Master the Slingshot.

Slingshot Quest uses a turn-based battle system, inspired by classic JRPGs. On your turn, you can choose to cast a spell, attack an enemy, use an item, defend, unleash a powerful SUPER move, or attempt to escape. Combat features a quick-time event minigame for attacks. When using spells or items, you'll need to carefully aim to hit as many targets at once and deal as much damage as possible.
